# The Business Work

> Practical AI agents, WhatsApp automation, CRM pipelines, and custom workflow software for small and medium businesses in India.

## Core Services
- **AI Agents & Chatbots:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com/services/ai-agents-chatbots — Automated customer support, lead qualification, and appointment booking on WhatsApp and web.
- **WhatsApp & Messaging Workflows:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com/services/whatsapp-workflows — Official WhatsApp Cloud API workflows, reminders, order updates, and Google Sheets/CRM sync.
- **CRM & Lead Pipelines:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com/services/crm-pipelines — Structured lead capture, follow-up automation, and sales pipeline visibility.
- **Custom Business Software & Integrations:** https://www.thebusinesswork.com/services/custom-integrations — Tailored internal tools, dashboards, and API integrations connecting Google Workspace, billing, and operations.
